text:
mike r.: quick favor — i'm seeing a small latency bump on nightly for gpt-small. can someone run a mini nsys + torch.profiler capture so we can compare flamegraphs?

sophia l.: i can take it. which commit/hash + input profile do you want? and should i include kv-cache traces?

mike r.: thx. use commit c3f9a2b (the one used in the nightly job). input: 1 request, seq_len=128, batch=1 (same as the regression test). please capture kv-cache info. keep traces small: 1 warmup, 3 measured iters.

sophia l.: ok. i'll run on dedicated-stable (A100-40G). plan: nsys for system+cuda trace and torch.profiler for operator level + stack. will upload artifacts to s3://redwood-perf/minicaptures/2060123456/.

sophia l.: nsys CLI i'm going to use (for reference):
```
NSYS_OUTPUT=mini_c3f9a2b
nsys profile --output $NSYS_OUTPUT --trace=cuda,osrt --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi --sample=none --env="KVCACHE=1" -- python -m perf_runner --model gpt-small --seq 128 --batch 1 --warmup 1 --iters 3
```

sophia l.: torch.profiler snippet to attach inside perf_runner (will write to /tmp/torchprof-mini):
```python
with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU, torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA],
    schedule=torch.profiler.schedule(wait=1, warmup=0, active=3),
    record_shapes=True, with_stack=True) as prof:
    for i in range(5):
        run_inference_step()
        prof.step()
prof.export_chrome_trace('/tmp/torchprof-mini/trace.json')
```

anand k.: quick check — please also dump the model's kv-cache hit/miss counters and torch.cuda.memory_summary() after the measured iters. small KV mismatches can look like perf regressions.

sophia l.: good call. i'll add counters to logs and include mem summary.

sophia l.: uploading once done. will scrub API keys and user data before upload.

jen t.: please add a short note in the artifact metadata: commit, docker image tag, driver version, cuda/cuDNN, and the exact CLI used. that'll make diffs easier.

sophia l.: will do — metadata.json will include {commit, docker, driver, cuda, seq_len, batch, warmup, iters}.

perf-bot: artifact upload started: s3://redwood-perf/minicaptures/2060123456/mini_c3f9a2b.nsys, torchprof/trace.json

mike r.: awesome. once uploaded can you paste the flamegraph svg link here? i'll run the regression diff against previous nightly. @anand k., @jen t. please eyeball for kv-cache vs kernel-frame regressions.

sophia l.: uploaded and shared link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-perf/minicaptures/2060123456/mini_c3f9a2b.flamegraph.svg (publicly accessible to team).

anand k.: quick look: i see a slight shift in cudnn::convolution_forward on iteration 2 — will dig into kernel launch times. attaching a quick grep: `nsys nvtx --report | grep convolution`

jen t.: nice catch. if it's kernel-level we should check driver+cuda; also rerun with CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 to force sync and see if scheduling is the issue.

sophia l.: noted will re-run with sync flag if needed. thanks all. cc mike for follow-up. :thumbsup:

mike r.: thanks team — this is great. i'll file a tiny regression ticket and link the artifacts.
